name: @d3ara1n/pi-mesh
description: Agent mesh for pi — peer discovery + cross-instance transport. The neutral foundation that pi-peek-agent, chat-room, and other multi-instance workflows build on. Self-sufficient: install alone to discover peers and self-introduce a role.
